subject: POC commitment checklist + rescue items to keep trial on track
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@fibretech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC commitment checklist + rescue items to keep trial on track

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. As promised, I put together a concise commitment checklist so we can get the POC started next week and avoid the usual procurement/setup delays. The goal is a 3-week trial focused on: 1) retrieval accuracy on your product docs, 2) sub-second median latency for search flows, and 3) end-user quality as measured by the sample prompts you shared.

Action checklist (please confirm owners/dates):
- Procurement: signed SOW or PO to enable reserved capacity (owner: FibreTech procurement) — target: Wed 28 Apr
- Environment access: VPN & service account for our infra engineer (owner: Tom) — target: Tue 27 Apr
- Data ingest: sanitized docs exported to shared Drive folder (owner: FibreTech Product) — target: Tue 27 Apr
- Success metrics: populate the attached spreadsheet with baseline numbers for search latency and accuracy (owner: Tom + Product) — target: Wed 28 Apr
- Technical kickoff: 60-min session (Redwood eng + FibreTech infra) — propose Thu 29 Apr 10:00am PT

Notes / risk areas we flagged: procurement timelines (PO vs SOW), and a mismatch on which dataset will be included in week 1. If procurement slips beyond 28 Apr we will pivot to a lightweight API sandbox to validate prompts while the reserved capacity is approved.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (stub), FibreTech-POC-success-metrics.xlsx (stub)

Next steps: can you confirm owners and whether procurement will provide a PO or sign SOW? Also confirm whether Thu 29 Apr 10:00am PT works for kickoff.

Appreciate it — we want to make this frictionless.

—
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@fibretech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fibretech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC commitment checklist + rescue items to keep trial on track

Priya —

Thanks for the clear checklist, that helps. Quick updates:
- Procurement: Procurement indicated they need a PO rather than signing SOWs for pilots. I'll loop them in to confirm the PO template and timeline. I copied procurement@fibretech.com.
- Environment access: I can provision a service account and share it with your engineer; I expect this to be done by Tue 27 Apr.
- Data ingest: Product will extract the sanitized set but we can only include the first 2 months of logs for week 1 (compliance). They will upload to the Drive link you provided by Tue 27 Apr.
- Success metrics: I'll start filling the spreadsheet; expect an initial baseline by Wed 28 Apr EOD.

Kickoff: Thu 29 Apr 10:00am PT works for me.

Risks: PO could take until mid-May depending on approvals. If that happens we prefer to run a parallel sand-boxed validation (public API tokens) so we can still validate prompts and metrics.

Tom
Director, Product Engineering
FibreTech

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: POC commitment checklist + rescue items to keep trial on track

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding the response from Tom at FibreTech. Main ask: procurement wants a PO (may delay) but they confirmed the environment and partial dataset for week 1. Can we triage as follows:

1) Marissa — can you share a short PO-friendly summary (1 page) that maps the SOW items to a PO line-items view? Procurement often wants a SKU/price row per deliverable — if you can draft this by Fri 23 Apr EOD, it will speed approval.
2) Ben — can you put an engineer on standby to do a quick sandbox kickoff (API-token based) in case PO slips past 28 Apr? If we can run a 48–72 hour prompt validation in a sandbox it de-risks the trial.

If both items are green we can keep Thu 29 Apr kickoff on the calendar and use the session to validate network access and the initial ingest.

Thanks — short timeline here so quick confirmations appreciated.

—
Priya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@fibretech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Gentle nudge: items for POC kickoff (Thu 29 Apr)

Tom —

Following up quickly as we approach the kickoff on Thu. Current status from our side:
- Marissa is drafting the PO-friendly one-pager and will share by EOD today.
- Ben has an engineer on standby for a sandbox session if needed.

Outstanding from FibreTech:
- Procurement confirmation on PO vs SOW (owner: procurement@fibretech.com) — this will drive reserved capacity provisioning.
- Drive folder with sanitized docs (owner: FibreTech Product) — still expecting upload Tue 27 Apr; please confirm if that's changed.
- Baseline numbers in the success-metrics sheet (owner: Tom) — we need these by Wed 28 Apr to instrument our dashboards.

If procurement indicates PO will take >1 week, we'll proceed with a sandbox validation during week 1 and schedule the reserved capacity work for week 2 — this keeps momentum and still gives you confidence on the quality metrics.

Would you be able to confirm procurement timing by EOD today? Even a short note from procurement@fibretech.com acknowledging they received the PO draft will unblock our Finance team.

On Thu's kickoff we will: 1) validate access, 2) ingest sample documents, 3) run initial prompt set and collect baseline metrics. Agenda will be 60 minutes.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Priya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
